# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** married  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** Mount Holly  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** belle and beauty of the class  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Cressida Lindsay  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressy is a broad-scale beauty with large brown eyes, a lopsided smile, and curls. She is described as looking like a delicate, ethereal fairy, particularly on her wedding day.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Cressy is lighthearted, charming, dramatic, and entertaining, possessing a loyal nature entirely free from snobbery. Though occasionally thoughtless, indecisive, and reluctant to dwell on disagreeable topics, she stays composed under pressure. Despite her whimsical demeanor, she is exceptionally intelligent.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## History

Cressida Lindsay enrolled at Wexcombe College as a Freshman student, rapidly introducing Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis to her extensive social circle due to her status, beauty, and charm. During her initial year, she was widely pursued by male students, including Hector and Orlando. Desiring closer companionship, she moved into Tabby’s Place alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby, adapting to their modest rules and learning basic domestic chores. Over the summer at Prospect Point, she bonded with Ezra Hale and resolved to secure a proposal from him. Despite initial opposition from her mother, she successfully gained her family's approval for their engagement. After graduating from Wexcombe with Honors in Mathematics, she married Ezra Hale the following June.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Quotes

> No, no, my dear. Shyness is not one of the numerous faults—or good qualities—possessed by Cressida Lindsay—Cressy as a nickname. Please use Cressy for me from the start. Well then, what are your names?  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

> Oh, why should that matter to me? It is far superior to share a simple meal of herbs alongside your friends than to eat a fattened ox in an isolated boardinghouse. Do not assume that I care only for my belly, girls. I would happily survive on mere bread and water—accompanied by just a tiny bit of jam—provided you allow me to join you.  <sub>[v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053)</sub>

> Broken hearts—or any disagreeable topic—are things I prefer not to think about.  <sub>[v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003)</sub>

> If possible, I intend to get him to propose marriage to me,  <sub>[v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023)</sub>

> I believe that any space in which a person experiences dreams, grief, joy, and life grows bound up with those occurrences and gains a distinct character. Were I to step into this room half a century in the future, I know it would whisper ‘Nell, Nell’ in my direction. We’ve shared such wonderful moments in this spot, sweetie! All the conversations, laughs, and warm, friendly gatherings! Oh, goodness! My wedding to Ez takes place in June, and I am certain my joy will be absolute. Yet at this very moment, my wish is for this delightful Wexcombe existence to continue without end.  <sub>[v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005)</sub>
